title: Evertse 1984: sums of S-units and linear recurrences
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the whole of J.-H. Evertse, On sums of S-units and linear recurrences (Compositio Math. 53 (1984)), built on the repository's libraries ArithmeticHeights and DiophantineApproximation, whose p-adic Subspace Theorem (Schlickewei's, the paper's Theorem 4) it uses. The library Evertse1984 is sorry-free and within Lean's three standard axioms. It proves Theorem 2 (a lower bound for S-integral sums without vanishing subsums, at any set of places), Theorem 1 (finitely many admissible projective solutions of x₀ + ⋯ + xₙ = 0), Corollaries 1 and 2, Lemmas 1 and 2 (polynomial values and shifted polynomial quotients that are S-units), Theorem 3 (for a non-degenerate linear recurrence with at least two characteristic roots, the largest prime ideal norm of u_r / u_s tends to infinity), and Corollaries 3 and 4 (P(u_r) → ∞; u_r = u_s has finitely many solutions r ≠ s). It also compares the paper's cited Theorem 4, the repository's p-adic Subspace Theorem. Fourteen statements are compared.
